route.rationale: new audit verb and decision-log refusal change public CLI contracts; hooks plus decision store plus doctrine

cells.title: Nudge a leader to search knowledge before its first code read in a turn
cells.action: Follow the Contract for kbc-1 in docs/history/knowledge-first-lean-decisions/plan.md. A leader code read (Read/Glob/Grep or a read-shaped Bash command on packages/, src/ or a source file, never docs/, .bee/, skills/ or *.md) in a turn with no bee knowledge search/context yet gets one PreToolUse advisory (the main.rs:917-934 shape, no permissionDecision) naming rule agents-knowledge-before-code and the exact command .bee/bin/bee knowledge search --text "<what you need>". Never deny. Once per turn; UserPromptSubmit (prompt-context) resets the session turn state under .bee/cache/. Silent for BEE_HERDING_WORKER and for payloads with agent_id or agent_type. The rule text lives only in packages/bee/LEADER.md as a rule block; refresh .bee/LEADER.md and the rule index. Write the behavior tests first and watch them fail.

truths: A leader code read with no knowledge search in the turn gets one advisory naming the exact search command
A read after bee knowledge search or context in the same turn is silent
A worker (BEE_HERDING_WORKER or agent_id payload) never gets the nudge
The nudge fires at most once per turn and re-arms at the next UserPromptSubmit
The rule text has one home in packages/bee/LEADER.md and the hook only points to it

cells.title: Add the audit log, write gate auto-approvals to it, keep audit tags out of decisions
cells.action: Follow the Contract for kbc-2 in docs/history/knowledge-first-lean-decisions/plan.md. Add .bee/audit.jsonl (same root resolution as the decision store, merge=union) with the closed kind set, verbs bee audit log and bee audit list, and the module API has_entry / newest_note for the doors. bee gate --actor auto appends one gate-bypass row after the stamp write. bee decisions log refuses audit-only tags (gate-bypass and the ten *-deferral kinds) naming bee audit log. decisions active/search, status recent decisions and the preamble recent decisions hide audit-only tagged rows unless --tag names that kind; never rewrite decisions.jsonl. List audit.jsonl beside decisions.jsonl in the worktree merge bookkeeping exemption and the gitattributes template. Regenerate help with bee dev regen. Tests first, seen red.

truths: bee audit log appends a row to .bee/audit.jsonl and bee audit list returns it; an unknown kind refuses
bee gate --actor auto writes one gate-bypass audit row and no decision
bee decisions log refuses gate-bypass and *-deferral tags and names bee audit log
decisions search hides legacy audit-tagged rows unless --tag asks for them, and decisions.jsonl is never rewritten

cells.title: Read door deferrals from the audit log and the legacy decision rows
cells.action: Follow the Contract for kbc-3 in docs/history/knowledge-first-lean-decisions/plan.md. Every door that reads a *-deferral decision (close.rs judge, uat, capture, knowledge-freshness, impact, routing, doc; leader_check.rs; dissent.rs; set_gate.rs capture-deferral) reads the audit log first through the kbc-2 module API, then the legacy decision rows. feature-local stays a decision tag. Every refusal text that told the agent to log a *-deferral decision names bee audit log --kind <k> --feature <f> --note instead. Tests first, seen red: an audit row satisfies each door, a legacy decision row still does.

truths: An audit row of each deferral kind satisfies its door
A legacy deferral decision row still satisfies its door
No door refusal text tells the agent to log a deferral decision

cells.title: Point doctrine and skills at the audit log for bookkeeping
cells.action: Follow the Contract for kbc-4 in docs/history/knowledge-first-lean-decisions/plan.md. One rule line in packages/bee/LEADER.md § Capture what settles: decisions keep rules, behavior and trade-offs; gate audit, close/merge/release/scribing/promote/handoff bookkeeping and door deferrals go to bee audit log. Remove every instruction to log a gate auto-approval audit decision (preamble render.rs, session_close nudges.rs, skills/bee-hive references) since bee gate --actor auto now writes the audit row. Replace every decisions log --tags <x>-deferral instruction in skills with bee audit log --kind <x>-deferral. Add docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/audit-log.md citing plan D3-D6, no raw decision ids. Refresh .bee/LEADER.md and any rendered skill copies with bee dev regen.

truths: No doctrine, skill, preamble or nudge text tells the agent to log a gate auto-approval or a deferral as a decision
packages/bee/LEADER.md names bee audit log as the bookkeeping home
